summary: Can-Fite BioPharma filed a Form 6-K on July 20, 2026, furnishing a press release about positive Phase 2a pancreatic cancer data being accepted for presentation at the ESMO Congress. This is a routine clinical development update for a biotech firm. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing is purely informational regarding scientific meeting acceptance and clinical progress. Accordingly, it does not qualify as a special situation requiring classification under defined categories.
